prompts.name: actions-01.txt
prompts.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent 4 by 4 character animation source atlas, 16 separate RGBA sprites.
Input image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET (druid actions-01 atlas). Input image 2 is the fixed equipment reference (druid frame-00).
Primary request: repair only equipment identity across all 16 cells of image 1. Preserve every original pose, face expression, hand position, object, object interaction, and 4x4 cell placement. Keep the original blue-haired chibi character and original drawing style.
Use exactly the reference's same brown branching antlers with leaves and green forehead diamond; same leaf shoulders, collar, dark green robe with gold vine pattern, purple center skirt panel, oval blue belt gem, brown bracers and boots. Do not redesign the clothing or patterns between cells. Restore exactly ONE wooden curled-branch staff with the same hanging green diamond gem and green leaves in EVERY humanoid cell. The staff is fixed on the character's right-back side, appearing on viewer LEFT in front-facing poses, like reference image 2. It is securely back-mounted so both hands remain free for their existing actions. The wooden upper curl and green gem must be clearly visible beside the character at upper-arm/head-base height; shaft follows the back mounting, behind arms and props, consistent local position, not floating and not duplicated. Retain sensible occlusion behind hair/arms without hiding the whole identifying staff.
Specific cell invariants in row-major order:
Row1 cells0-1: juggling exactly three colored balls at the existing two different phases. Preserve all balls and hands. Cells2-3: gomoku board, black and white stones, bowls, thinking then placing stone.
Row2 cells4-5: arms-down left/right glances. Cells6-7: moon, mooncakes and eating/serving phases.
Row3 cells8-9: two distinct maid-dance poses, leg positions and arm gestures. Cells10-11: distressed empty purse, then holding gathered money pouch.
Row4 cells12-13: counting coins with pouch, then concerned thinking. Cells14-15: tipping an empty money bag, then showing it empty. Preserve different expressions and all money/bag objects.
Constraints: keep a square 4x4 atlas with sixteen occupied equally sized cells in exactly the same order, each full sprite stays within its cell with transparent separation. Match original canvas size and character framing. Genuine transparent background/alpha, no color backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no grid lines, no labels, no extra objects. Do not replace diverse actions with standing poses. Do not change limbs or pose layouts. No added cape, no new weapon, no alternate armor. Edit only equipment consistency and missing back-mounted staff.
